entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: The transition from agrarian handicraft economies to machine manufacturing (c. 1760-1840), originating in Britain. Powered by steam engines, textile mills, iron foundries, and coal mines, the Industrial Revolution transformed economic production, social structure, urbanization, and living standards — arguably the most consequential economic transformation in human history.
